eyebrow.zh: 本地 · 多账户 · 一条命令

headline.zh:
给 AI agent
一次挂上 N 个号
headline.en:
Give your AI agent
N accounts at once

sub.zh: 一条本地桥挂载 N 个 Google 账户，刷新令牌锁进系统钥匙串；agent 一次调用读遍所有收件箱。
sub.en: A local bridge mounts N Google accounts and locks refresh tokens in the OS keychain; your agent reads every inbox in one call.

body.zh: 官方连接器一次只认一个号——想读另一个账户就得登出登入，或跨号复制粘贴。N-Bridge 一次挂上 N 个 Google 账户；agent 一次调用就扇出、合并、按账户打标返回。
body.en: Official connectors see one account at a time — reaching another means signing out and back in, or copy-pasting across accounts. N-Bridge mounts N Google accounts once; one agent call fans out, merges, and tags results by account.

chips: › 一次挂 N 个 Google 账户
› 邮件／日历／网盘一次合并

title.zh: 授权一次，令牌锁进钥匙串
title.en: Authorize once, tokens locked in the keychain

body.zh: 浏览器走完一次同意，刷新令牌就存进系统钥匙串（macOS 钥匙串／Windows 凭据管理器／Linux Secret Service）——永不明文落盘、永不离开本机，下一次不用再授权。
body.en: After one browser consent, the refresh token lands in the OS keychain (macOS Keychain / Windows Credential Manager / Linux Secret Service) — never written to disk in plaintext, never leaving your machine. No re-authorization next time.

title.zh: 一条命令，接上你的 agent
title.en: One command, wired into your agent

body.zh: 一条 nbridge up 启动桥，交给 agent 连。在你的 agent 配置里加一行，它就能一次读遍所有已挂账户。
body.en: One nbridge up starts the bridge for your agent to connect. Add a single line to your agent config and it reads every mounted account at once.

chips: › 支持 Claude Code / Codex / hermes-agent

title.en: All on your machine, free forever

body.zh: 桥跑在你自己的机器上，刷新令牌永不离开本机；MIT 开源、本地永久免费——没有云端要托管，没有账号要注册。
body.en: The bridge runs on your own machine and refresh tokens never leave it; MIT licensed and free forever locally — no cloud to host, no account to sign up for.

headline.zh: 一条命令，让你的 agent 读遍每个收件箱
headline.en: One command, and your agent reads every inbox

sub.zh: 本地永久免费、MIT 开源。挂上你的 Google 号，刷新令牌锁进系统钥匙串、永不离开本机。
sub.en: Free forever locally, MIT licensed. Mount your Google accounts; refresh tokens stay locked in the OS keychain, never leaving your machine.

tag.zh: MIT 开源 · 本地永久免费 · 独立维护
tag.en: MIT open source · Free forever locally · Independently maintained
